## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` and `python scripts/zf.py validate` pass (if scripts or data changed)
- [ ] New UI text goes through `t()` and has a Hebrew entry in `src/i18n/he.js`
- [ ] No personal data, real listings, phone numbers or secrets added
- [ ] Docs / AGENTS.md updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes (desktop and ~390px mobile)
